title: Apple MacBook Pro 16" 2021 M1 Pro 16GB/512GB $1,649 + Shipping and 60 discount on purchase $2000 @ SwiftBuy
body:
Deal: Apple MacBook Pro 16" 2021 M1 Pro 16GB/512GB $1,649 + Shipping and 60 discount on purchase $2000 @ SwiftBuy

[Jaduqimon] Refurb 32/512 ones go for around 800 - 900 often on ebay
[solidice] This isn’t a great deal. ~$1200 would be the upper limit.
[Grey 13] Agreed. $1,000 and these can sell relatively quick.
Also $20 for standard shipping to Metro VIC. You'd think at 1,649 the shipping would be included 🤷
[Commodore64] A horrible deal, and these only have another 1-2 years of updates left on them.
[0jay] i reckon it's a fair bet they'll support the m series macs for as long as they can (as distinct from as long as they can get away with)
[SwiftBuy] Pro models historically receive slightly longer support than base consumer models, meaning support could last through 2028
[Commodore64] It’s 2026 already so that’s 1-2 years..
A rather large investment for first generation apple silicon.
[John Doh] And the battery would have slightly degraded due to age.
[BargainGeezer] 2019 Intel models still have a year left on them, so realistically these models have 3-4 years left on them.
But if you’re going to be keeping it for the long haul, idk why you’d bother on a 2021 model. Even spending an extra $1k is worth it if you’ll get an additional 4-5 years out of it.
[dosada] That's all true but where do I get a 16 inch mscbppk pro for a grand more?
[solidice] Why not just offer your best price from the start instead of seeing how many people buy into awful price, then adjust if you’re not making sales?
[AlexF] Why not just offer your best price from the start …
imperative for capitalism is greed.
[Mijora1] i agree overpriced. machine will stop receiving major updates in 1 to 2 years
[0jay] This is new Boxed sealed With Apple Care Warranty
it's not a refurb
[0jay] y can argue you think that likely but unless you've purchased one and found a refurb you're just making a claim
[TheDukeOfNukem] without paying the prices these machines originally commanded.
Sure, I got the 13 inch, but I bought the this Pro for the missus in like 2021 for 1850 at JB. This seems somewhat massively overpriced.
[Spacexyz] Where did you guys get those brand new m1 MacBooks? It’s almost 2027…
[tac459] Might be a brand new machine but the 5+ year old battery is potentially cooked anyway, due to age, together with unknown storage conditions.
Better off with a refurb for half the price and whose condition you can ascertain before buying.
[0jay] if the battery's cooked you can make an applecare claim
[tac459] Sure, spend $1.7k on a 'brand new' laptop, crack open the box to ship it straight to Apple for servicing. What an experience!
FWIW, I paid $1.3k for an M2 Pro 16" grade A refurb, 94% battery health. Much better value than this
[0jay] yeah if you say so
folks likely to buy this're probly folks who just want a nice, reliable lappie wi a good warranty
compare geekbench results for an m1 pro chip as against the a18 in the neo then think about screen quality, screensize, trackpad, keyboard blahblahblah
if you're after a recent cpu pro machine walk on
[tac459] @0jay: Not sure anyone, especially anyone looking for their first Mac, would consider it 'reliable' if there's a strong possibility that the first thing they're doing after unboxing is sending it off for a warranty repair.
Also, why are you comparing it to the Neo? They're half the price of this 'deal' and aimed at a totally different demographic.
It's ok to say you have buyer's remorse mate, no one's going to judge you. You still get to enjoy a powerful laptop regardless of what you paid.
[0jay] @tac459: you've made some assuptions both about battery life and expectations of battery life of the buyer
i bought a nib m1 ipad pro in 2025 (manufactured 2021), that battery still reports in coconut battery as 103% battery health (down from 107% when i first charged it up)
these were discontinued 2023 and may be newer than my ipad but for a lot of folks (including myself) lappies are portables that live on the desk
my secondhand m1 air lives on the desk at 92% health idling at 52% charge thru aldente
neo with 512 and touch id is $1249 ('half the price'??) as for diff demo a 5 year old pro model is not for any demo as such, it's just a more capable machine for a similar price but with much better specs
i did not buy one of these (nor did i upvote the deal) but the shade you're throwing's pretty lame tbh
[o53djz7qTPY4der] This is a wild price for a 5-6 year old CPU. And you get to pay for shipping!
[frkino] way over-priced for an M1, market rate is sub-$1k
[asspray] 16" macbook pro …. with nicest screen. new too.
[SlowCarSlow] Same store had an M2 model with same specs for $300 less a few weeks ago. Even if you are after something like this, worth waiting to see if this one drops.
[xavierod] I've been watching these for last few months on eBay and FB - beat up ones are $1000 at the lowest so this really isn't a bad price for new. They're popular because at that price still a much better laptop than the Neo.
[The Edge] Damn!
Who are they kidding posting this garbage deal.
Clearly a store to be aware of
[M00Cow] M1 Pro's performance without paying the prices these machines originally commanded.
with that logic, I've got an iphone 12pro 128gb. I'll sell it to you for $1500, A14 performance without paying the prices these machines originally commanded.
[scud70] what in tarnation….. dang :|, this does not sound like a good deal …
[gunso] Paid this price 2 years ago with 32gb ram
